description: Cryptstalker Wristguards Level 60 Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Cryptstalker Wristguards if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Wristguards, 6 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 2 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Wristguards - Wartorn Chain Scrap x 6 - Arcanite Bar - Cured Rugged Hide x 2
name: Cryptstalker Wristguards
